not_verified_on_staging: This lane adds migration files, a pgTAP test, read-only check SQL and one static gateway test. Nothing is applied from the PR: each file is applied later through RUN-MIGRATION.yml, one file per dispatch, after the owner approves the files and the target database (collaboration.md section 7d). Staging shares the production database, so the staging deploy runs no code that reads anything new (the gateway routes that call the RPCs ship in the tenant-admin-api lane). The staging check is read-only: docs/validation/VTID-05493/live-before.sql before, post-apply-checks.sql after, rollback-check.sql after a rollback. No suite points at vitanaland.com.

tests.reason: Static assertions over the two migration files, the rollbacks, the read-only checks, the queue rows and the drift baseline.
